serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
After Annalie’s “date” I was wondering…
Is Annalie even capable of finding anyone for herself?
It’s not like she’s not pretty or something, but… {{wi}}I’m more concerned about her character…
I've known her for a while, and during that time, I've never heard of any boyfriends, ex-boyfriends, or anyone similar.
Most guys would probably be thrilled about having a pervy girl like her, but maybe she’s so pervy that it has the opposite effect?
That would explain why she’s still alone…
Perhaps the men are worried that they won’t be able to tame her?
It would be rude to ask her that directly so I won’t, but I keep wondering…
#bot.Expression.Clear
You: {f_botName}, did Annalie ever tell you something about having a boyfriend? 
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: What. Are you interested in the position?
You: N-No, it’s not like that. I’m just worried that she will stay alone forever.
#bot.Expression.Clear
Bot: No, I didn’t hear anything about it.
Bot: She’s an attractive woman, but I guess her flesh is not getting any younger. 
You: I wouldn’t go that far…
Bot: I could prepare a strategy that would maximize her chances of finding a mate if you want.
You: That won’t be necessary. There’s nothing worse than an unwanted help.
You: To be honest I can’t even imagine what her boyfriend would be like. Her tastes are peculiar and she seems very fussy. 
Bot: Hmmm
Bot: It’s true, if she keeps being uninterested in the opposite sex her bloodline will end with her. 
Same goes for me…
You: You seem very judgmental when it comes to these things…
Bot: I’m a bot so I will live forever, but humans need to procreate. Passing on your genetic material is the closest you can get to immortality. 
Bot: Of course people can immortalize themselves in history by committing great acts or creating a wonderful piece of art, but that only applies to a select few.
Bot: Most of you need to engage in the endless cycle of birth and death.
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: It’s so very inconvenient… {{wi}}I can’t even imagine what you are going through every day…
You: Come on, it’s not that bad…
…right? It’s not that bad, right?!
#bot.Expression.clear
You: I don’t think most people think of life that way.
Bot: I see. It seems like humankind’s lack of intelligence might actually be a blessing in disguise! 
I don’t like where this conversation went, I can feel how my will to live leaks out of my body…
